nd83348b36c2.s: India's merchandise exports in FY 2025–26 were about:
nd83348b36c2.x: India's merchandise exports reached an all-time high of US$ 441.78 billion in FY 2025–26, up 0.93%.

n4127978e6c7.s: The rise in India's merchandise imports in FY 2025–26 was driven mainly by imports of:
n4127978e6c7.x: FY26 merchandise imports of about US$775 bn (up 7.45%) were driven by a jump in gold and silver imports.

nfbe1366a736.s: India's FTAs could cover about 75% of its exports, but their actual utilisation is only about:
nfbe1366a736.x: India's FTAs could cover approximately 75% of exports, but actual utilisation is only around 20–30%.

n3e5a2948711.s: As per the 2024 recalculation, the length of India's coastline is about:
n3e5a2948711.x: The 2024 recalculation put India's coastline at about 11,098 km; 7,517 km was the earlier figure.

nworld-geography-5-6.s: Which country has the world's largest area under cotton cultivation?
nworld-geography-5-6.x: India has the largest area under cotton, though its yields are lower than China's.

n8ac22799b7e.s: About what share of India's LPG imports comes from West Asia?
n8ac22799b7e.x: About 90% of India's LPG imports (and more than 40% of crude oil imports) come from West Asia.

nf9722f77650.s: Under the RBI's July 2022 framework, India's exports and imports can be invoiced and settled in rupees through:
nf9722f77650.x: The July 2022 framework permits invoicing and settlement in Indian rupees through Special Rupee Vostro Accounts (SRVAs).

nf9f2aa08551.s: Asia's first Export Processing Zone, set up in 1965, was at:
nf9f2aa08551.x: Kandla EPZ, established in 1965, was Asia's first Export Processing Zone.

n29de2b9925d.s: As of June 2026, India's trade-agreement count stood at:
o: 14 FTAs covering 6 countries, talks with 27 more
42 FTAs covering 15 countries, talks with 27 more
27 FTAs covering 15 countries, talks with 42 more
15 FTAs covering 27 countries, talks with 42 more
n29de2b9925d.x: In June 2026 India had 15 FTAs covering 27 countries and was in talks with 42 more countries.

n9f6e1824170.s: Which chokepoint was reported closed in early March 2026 during the US–Israel war on Iran?
n9f6e1824170.x: The Strait of Hormuz was reported closed in early March 2026 during the US–Israel war on Iran.

n8e669c02f6f.s: After the Houthis took Perim Island in September 2026, traffic was disrupted through:
n8e669c02f6f.x: After the Houthis took Perim Island, traffic through both Hormuz and Bab-el-Mandeb was reported disrupted in September 2026.

n6b9c15a2a54.s: Which waterway, linking the Mediterranean and the Red Sea, shortens the Europe–Asia route by up to 7,000 km?
n6b9c15a2a54.x: The Suez Canal links the Mediterranean and the Red Sea and shortens the Europe–Asia route by up to 7,000 km, giving it the greatest economic and strategic significance.

n5353bdef4ee.s: Trade with China through which passes has been suspended since 2020?
o: Lipulekh, Shipki La and Nathu La
Khardung La, Chang La and Bara-Lacha La
Nathu La, Zoji La and Bomdi La
n5353bdef4ee.x: China-border trade through Lipulekh, Shipki La and Nathu La has been suspended since 2020.

n6df9b78e226.s: Which was the first major port on the east coast established after Independence (declared on 18 April 1966)?
n6df9b78e226.x: Paradip was declared a major port on 18 April 1966, the first major port on the east coast established after Independence.

nb0bd163014f.s: Which one of the following is NOT correctly matched?
o: Kamarajar — India's first corporatised major port
V.O. Chidambaranar — Artificial all-weather deep-sea harbour north of Adam's Bridge
Paradip — Oldest artificial port of the east coast
nb0bd163014f.x: Chennai, not Paradip, is the oldest artificial port of the east coast; Paradip, in the Mahanadi delta, was commissioned in 1966.

nindian-geography-48-3.s: Which of the following harbour–State pairs is correctly matched?
nindian-geography-48-3.x: Udupi (Malpe) is in Karnataka. Janjira is in Maharashtra, Kochi in Kerala and Kakinada in Andhra Pradesh.

nindian-geography-48-7.s: Which of the following port–State pairs is correctly matched?
nindian-geography-48-7.x: Kamarajar is in Tamil Nadu. Visakhapatnam is in Andhra Pradesh, Haldia in West Bengal and Paradip in Odisha.

nindian-geography-38-4.s: Which of the following port–State pairs is correctly matched?
nindian-geography-38-4.x: Mormugao is in Goa. Mumbai is in Maharashtra, Paradip in Odisha and Kamarajar (Ennore) in Tamil Nadu.

nc3b180084d1.s: Which one of the following is NOT an import item of India, India being an exporter of it?
nc3b180084d1.x: India exports iron ore rather than importing it (APPSC 2018). Crude petroleum, gold and edible oils are major imports.

n48d7001d673.s: Sri City, a multi-product zone with SEZ, DTZ, FTWZ and Electronics Manufacturing Cluster components, is in which district?
n48d7001d673.x: Sri City is in Tirupati district and combines a multi-product SEZ, DTZ, Free Trade Warehousing Zone and Electronics Manufacturing Cluster.

nc43ec917f5c.s: After bifurcation, Andhra Pradesh turned to port-led development mainly because it:
o: lost its major ports to Telangana
was barred by the SEZ Act from inland industry
nc43ec917f5c.x: After bifurcation, Andhra Pradesh lost Hyderabad's industrial clusters and responded by pursuing port-led development.

nf9c79339455.s:
Consider the following statements about India's services sector:
1. It contributes more than half of India's GVA.
2. It is the largest recipient of FDI.
Which of the above statement(s) is/are correct?
nf9c79339455.x: Services account for more than half of India's GVA and are the largest recipient of FDI, so both statements are correct.

n1acfde8f1f6.s: Which of the following place–State pairs is INCORRECTLY matched?
n1acfde8f1f6.x: Sarnath (like Kushinagar) is in Uttar Pradesh, not Bihar. Munnar is in Kerala, Mount Abu in Rajasthan and Bodh Gaya in Bihar.

n2121e4c2566.s: How many new sites were identified for the national-importance tag in 2022?
n2121e4c2566.x: The Culture Minister told the Lok Sabha that 20 new sites were identified for the national-importance tag in 2022.

n8c227766830.s: Which scheme helps States develop iconic tourist centres into global destinations?
n8c227766830.x: The Scheme for Special Assistance to States for Capital Investment (SASCI) assists States in developing iconic tourist centres into global destinations.

na1179d8ce59.s: Which of the following Andhra Pradesh tourism hub–character pairs is correctly matched?
na1179d8ce59.x: Amaravati is a heritage and Buddhist hub. Tirupati is spiritual, Araku is hill and eco-tourism, and Gandikota is heritage and adventure.

n0abe8d13552.s:
Arrange the following UNESCO World Heritage inscriptions in chronological order:
A. Moidams of the Ahom Dynasty
B. Ramappa Temple and Dholavira
C. Maratha Military Landscapes of India
D. Santiniketan and Sacred Ensembles of the Hoysalas
n0abe8d13552.x: Ramappa and Dholavira (2021), Santiniketan and the Hoysalas (2023), Moidams (2024), Maratha Military Landscapes (2025): B, D, A, C.

nb3b1088dd08.s: Rushikonda, a certified Blue Flag beach, is located in:
nb3b1088dd08.x: Rushikonda Beach is in Visakhapatnam and is a certified Blue Flag beach.

n1e4d8c2aedf.s: The Statue of Unity is located at:
n1e4d8c2aedf.x: The Statue of Unity is at Kevadia, now also known as Ekta Nagar, in Gujarat.

n7c554dddae5.s: Besides the Atomic Energy Act, 1962, which law did the SHANTI Act, 2025 repeal while admitting private companies to nuclear power?
o: Civil Liability for Nuclear Damage Act, 2010
Mines and Minerals (Development and Regulation) Act, 1957
n7c554dddae5.x: The SHANTI Act, 2025 repeals the Atomic Energy Act, 1962 and the CLNDA, 2010, and permits the admission of private companies.

n885fbda1a30.s: Which one of the following is NOT a petroleum product?
n885fbda1a30.x: Anthracite is a grade of coal; naphtha, LPG and bitumen are petroleum products.

n11a23900dd9.s: Crude oil from the Rawa field is exported through a:
n11a23900dd9.x: Rawa exports crude through an SBM, or single buoy mooring.

nindian-geography-29-8.s: Which of the following refinery–State pairs is correctly matched?
nindian-geography-29-8.x: Mathura refinery is in Uttar Pradesh. Haldia is in West Bengal, Barauni in Bihar and Kochi in Kerala.

nindian-geography-29-13.s: The Tatipaka mini refinery in Andhra Pradesh belongs to:
nindian-geography-29-13.x: Tatipaka is an ONGC mini refinery; the Visakhapatnam refinery belongs to HPCL.

n6c685065da9.s: The primary function of a pumped storage project is to:
o: supply irrigation water to command areas
control floods in the river basin
store daytime solar power for night-time peak demand
n6c685065da9.x: Pumped storage stores surplus daytime electricity, particularly solar power, and releases it during night-time peak demand.

nworld-geography-26-6.s: Which of the following dam–capacity rank pairs is correctly matched?
nworld-geography-26-6.x: By capacity, Three Gorges is first, Baihetan second, Itaipu third and Xiluodu fourth.

nc70eee7c557.s: Among Canada, the USA, Russia and India, which has the densest railway network?
nc70eee7c557.x: Among these four countries, India has the densest railway network.

nworld-geography-17-7.s: Which of the following railway network pairs is correctly matched?
o: USA – includes the world's largest high-speed rail network
Russia – includes the world's largest high-speed rail network
nworld-geography-17-7.x: Russia's network is the third-longest at about 105,000 km. The USA's is about 220,000–250,000 km, and China's includes the largest high-speed network.

n93fd3f6a7b2.s: Which of the following food–adulterant pairs is NOT correctly matched?
o: Chilli powder — Brick powder or Sudan dyes
Milk — Water, detergent, urea or starch
n93fd3f6a7b2.x: Turmeric is adulterated with metanil yellow or lead chromate; argemone oil is the adulterant of mustard oil.

n1df40f05f89.s: Food irradiation destroys harmful organisms in food, without substantially altering nutrition, by using:
n1df40f05f89.x: Food irradiation uses ionising radiation to destroy harmful organisms without altering nutrition substantially.

nphysics-18-93.s: A camera, a compound microscope and a telescope all use which of the following to form real images?
nphysics-18-93.x: A camera, a compound microscope and a telescope all use convex lenses to form real images.

nchemistry-6-21.s: Which of the following use–material pairs is correctly matched?
o: Moderator in nuclear reactors – Activated charcoal
nchemistry-6-21.x: Activated charcoal adsorbs gases in gas masks. Diamond is used in glass cutters and graphite as a reactor moderator.

nefc81a5d4b1.s: Which of the following DST scheme pairs is correctly matched?
o: SATHI – Laboratory and infrastructure upgrading in departments
FIST – Regional access to high-end analytical instruments
SAIF – Shared professionally managed S&T infrastructure
PURSE – Grants based on research-publication performance
nefc81a5d4b1.x: PURSE gives grants based on research-publication performance. SATHI provides shared infrastructure, FIST upgrades laboratories and SAIF gives regional access to instruments.
